text:
maria (devex): Running into a recurring onboarding issue with the Python async client for Dedicated: users set REDWOOD_BASE_URL + HTTPS_PROXY + a custom CA file via REDWOOD_SSL_CA and see intermittent TLS unknown CA errors on first request.

maria (devex): Repro (very small):
```
import os
from redwood import AsyncClient

os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'] = 'https://dedicated-org.internal'
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://corp-proxy:3128'
os.environ['REDWOOD_SSL_CA'] = '/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem'

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key='x', base_url=os.getenv('REDWOOD_BASE_URL'))
    await c.generate('hello')
```

maria (devex): Error sample: `ssl.SSLError: [SSL: TLSV1_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA] tlsv1 alert unknown ca (_ssl.c:1123)`

devon (sdk): Sounds like aiohttp connector not getting the custom cafile when proxy is enabled. We create a default connector inside AsyncClient; proxy paths need the SSLContext attached explicitly.

sam (infra): Also check import-time construction. If client pools are created at import, env var changes in the same shell won't be picked up. That matches "first request after start" failures.

olivia (eng): Quick customer workaround: construct SSLContext explicitly and pass it in the constructor: `ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem')` then `AsyncClient(..., ssl=ctx)`. For now add that to sample app.

maria (devex): Customers expect env-only quickstart to work though. Can we make SDK fallback to honoring REDWOOD_SSL_CA even when HTTPS_PROXY is set?

devon (sdk): Yep. I'll open an issue and PR to build the aiohttp.TCPConnector with the SSLContext when REDWOOD_SSL_CA is present, and ensure proxy env triggers the same code path. I'll also add a small unit test mocking proxy env.

devon (sdk): Will also wrap the raw SSLError and raise a RedwoodSSLConfigurationError with a helpful message suggesting REDWOOD_SSL_CA or passing ssl=SSLContext.

sam (infra): Ping me on the PR for connector lifecycle — need to avoid leaking connectors per client and make reuse safe.

olivia (eng): Docs note: add a short health-check CLI snippet that validates base_url + cafile + proxy during onboarding. I'll draft a docs PR.

maria (devex): Thanks. I'll patch the quickstart with the explicit workaround until the fix lands and add a support snippet for Customer Success. Leaving this thread open until PR merged and docs updated. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for branch fix/async-proxy-ca. ETA ~20m.
